description.text: Aerospace science and technology is an engineering discipline that studies the design, manufacture, operation and control of aircraft (aircraft and spacecraft). It is based on mathematics, physics and mechanics, and integrates knowledge from multiple fields such as materials science, automatic control and information technology. Its core objective is to solve the problems of the movement laws, structural design, power systems and system integration of aircraft within and outside the atmosphere (aviation), and it is one of the core supporting disciplines for the country's high-end equipment manufacturing and national defense science and technology.

duration.text: The Aeronautical and Astronautical Science and Technology at Xi'an Jiaotong University is a 2 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

requirements.text: 1. Non-chinese citizens in good health;2. Degree and age requirementsApplicants to study for a master's degree in China must have a bachelor's degree and be under the age of 1835 years old;Those who come to China to pursue a doctoral degree must have a master's degree and be no older than the required ageForty years old.3.
